cache-images-count.why: Sanity check on the cache and a record of its header.

metal-newlibrarywithdata.why: Phase 1's biggest launch risk: whether tvOS Metal accepts Roblox's iOS-compiled metallib blobs. Looks for the loader entry point in the device's Metal.

coreui-deployment-platform.why: Phase 1: whether the device's CoreUI refuses an asset catalog whose deploymentPlatform is ios.

uitouch-ivars.why: Phase 6 click-to-tap preference 2 sets a synthesized UITouch's location, window, view and phase. Those are private ivars, so their names on tvOS 27.2 must come from the device. Anchored on the class declaration this time: the previous broad @property pattern matched 36,320 lines and was truncated before UITouch appeared.

uievent-ivars.why: A synthesized touch is carried by a UIEvent; same private-ivar question.

uidatepicker-class.why: Cross-check the nib-class finding against the class dump: UIDatePicker is exported by the device's UIKit and by tvOS SDK 27.2's UIKit.tbd, so it should appear here with its real superclass.

gc-cursor-classes.why: Confirm on the device, not just in the SDK, that the two classes the cursor depends on exist: GCEventViewController (focus-engine bypass) and GCMicroGamepad (the Siri Remote profile).

dyld-version.why: Evidence source 5: the dyld version this device ships, to compare against the dyld-1378 source the proxy mechanism was checked against. The previous search term 'dyld-1' matched only its own prefix.

objc-version.why: Evidence source 5: the objc4 version this device ships. The previous term 'objc4-' returned nothing.
